description: Use this when the user wants to compare asking prices per square metre between Greek areas (e.g. Kolonaki vs Glyfada) or asks what a budget such as €250k, €400k or €800k buys. Answers from Greca House's dated research snapshot of its own listings' asking prices, with sample sizes. A dated snapshot of Greca House's own listings' ASKING prices, not a whole-market transaction-price index. Do not use it for forecasts, predicted appreciation, next-year price growth, time-series trends or questions about the whole market's future prices. Do not add 'current market' figures from memory; other sources may be cited only if you actually retrieve them separately.

language.description: Language for listing text and links (en, el, ru, he, zh, ar).
